description: This file defines the NoteHistoryController class, managing note revision history including remote, session, and legacy revisions, with methods for selecting, restoring, duplicating, and deleting revisions.

classes.name: NoteHistoryController
classes.description: Controller class for managing note revision history, including fetching, selecting, restoring, duplicating, and deleting revisions.

methods.name: setSelectedRevision
methods.description: Sets the currently selected revision.

methods.name: setSelectedEntry
methods.description: Sets the currently selected entry.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the current selection of revision and entry.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a revision tab and resets selection and content state.

methods.name: setIsFetchingRemoteHistory
methods.description: Sets the fetching state for remote history.

methods.name: setContentState
methods.description: Sets the current content state.

methods.name: selectRemoteRevision
methods.description: Selects a remote revision, fetching its details.

methods.name: selectLegacyRevision
methods.description: Selects a legacy revision via action execution.

methods.name: selectSessionRevision
methods.description: Selects a session history revision.

methods.name: selectFirstRevision
methods.description: Selects the first revision based on current tab.

methods.name: selectPrevOrNextRemoteRevision
methods.description: Selects previous or next remote revision.

methods.name: setRemoteHistory
methods.description: Sets the remote history list.

methods.name: fetchRemoteHistory
methods.description: Fetches remote revision history from the server.

methods.name: setLegacyHistory
methods.description: Sets the legacy history list.

methods.name: fetchLegacyHistory
methods.description: Fetches legacy revision history via extensions.

methods.name: setSessionHistory
methods.description: Sets the session history list.

methods.name: fetchAllHistory
methods.description: Fetches all revision histories and initializes the first revision.

methods.name: resetHistoryState
methods.description: Resets all history lists.

methods.name: restoreRevision
methods.description: Restores a revision to the note after user confirmation.

methods.name: restoreRevisionAsCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a revision as a new note.

methods.name: deleteRemoteRevision
methods.description: Deletes a remote revision after user confirmation.
